name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 1.8V — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount 1.8V low-dropout (LDO) linear power regulator ICs in TSSOP packaging with HTSSOP-20 footprints.
selection_hints: Requires a 1.8V surface-mount LDO linear voltage regulator.
Target PCB layout uses an HTSSOP-20 footprint with exposed pad and thermal vias.
Selecting Tier A KiCad symbols such as TPS77718 or TPS77818.
avoid_when: Output voltages other than 1.8V are required.
PCB layout requires package families other than TSSOP or HTSSOP-20.
Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
